name: Disconnected mechanical coupling
summary: This indication identifies the disconnected state of a mechanical coupling.
description: This indication identifies the disconnected state of a mechanical coupling. The driving and driven elements are represented without an engaged torque or motion-transmission relationship in this state. Either element can still have electrical connections.
Use the state diagram or mechanism schedule to define what causes engagement. The disconnected coupling mark should not be substituted for a power isolation symbol.
readingNotes: Read the state within the documented mechanism sequence.
A disconnected coupling state is separate from the isolation of an electrical supply.
